title: RoutesResponse
description: Response of GET /api/routes. A route is an ordered list of Waypoints. Consecutive waypoints sharing a block_id belong to one Orbis session.

shots.description: The walk's script for the continuous Orbis generation: walk (one straight leg) → turn (short cue) → … → arrive. Played in order; the prompt changes only at shot boundaries. The backend always sends it; optional so older fixtures still validate.

video_prompt.description: Sent with set_prompt when the shot starts, held for its whole duration.

waypoint_start.description: First waypoint index this shot covers (for the evidence strip and minimap).

waypoint_end.description: Last waypoint index this shot covers, inclusive.

heading.description: Bearing in degrees to the next waypoint (0 = north, clockwise).

block_id.description: Stable id for the street segment between two intersections. Consecutive waypoints sharing it belong to one Orbis session.

image_url.description: e.g. /api/imagery/<block_id>/<heading>. null when image_available is false.

image_available.description: false => image_url is null and the renderer must show the unavailable state.

facts.description: Rendered verbatim in the evidence readout. Person 1 owns the wording.

Ambient.description: Numeric ambient light, so the seed grade is a continuous dial rather than a day/night switch (PLAN.md Phase 3; shape proposed by Person 1, agreed by Person 2). Optional in the schema only so an older fixture still validates — without it the grade assumes full night, which is what it did before this field existed.

phase.description: astral's phase at the requested time. `dawn` is included because backend/conditions.py sun_state() already produces it.

sun_altitude_deg.description: Solar altitude in degrees; negative below the horizon.

darkness.description: 0 = full daylight, 1 = fully dark (sun at or below astral's dusk, about -6 deg). The renderer grades the seed along this dial, so 7pm -> 11pm is a smooth change and never a cut to black.

Lighting.description: Structured lighting for the day->night seed grade (Person 1 owns it). Always present from the backend; optional in the schema only so a consumer can treat it as a progressive enhancement.

lit.description: OSM lit tag on this block's edges (and the street beside a mapped sidewalk).

lamp_count.description: Mapped streetlights on the whole block (Mapillary detections, clustered, plus OSM street_lamp).

side.description: Which sides of the street's centreline the block's lamps are on.

lamp_offsets_m.description: Metres ahead of this waypoint, along the route, of each lamp still ahead on this block. Ascending.

lamp_lateral_m.description: Same order and length as lamp_offsets_m: metres right (+) or left (-) of the street centreline, facing the waypoint heading. Beside a footpath with no street, relative to the walked line.

outages.description: 311 streetlight-out reports within 30m of the block in the 90 days before the requested time.
